text:
sam: Heads-up: Spectra wants to coordinate a small joint announcement + marketplace tile once the preview finishes. They also asked for SI readiness notes for our channel partners. Need opinions on timing and content.

zara-partner: Thanks Sam. Spectra is aiming for a soft announcement to OEM customers 2 weeks after EAP close, public marketplace listing 1 month after that. They want a co-branded tile and a how-to deployment doc for partners.

diego-eng: For the marketplace tile we'll need a verified image, minimum spec (vRAM, driver), and a short performance blurb. Can we reuse the bench results but call out "typical" vs "optimized" numbers?

meera-legal: Reminder: any co-branded assets must pass our logo use policy and press embargo terms in the NDA. If they want joint quotes, get those approved in writing.

toni-pp: I'll draft marketplace copy. Proposed short blurb: "Run Redwood Inference on Spectra's X1 accelerators for <2x latency at 75% throughput vs standard configs." Need validated numbers.

diego-eng: Don't use comparatives we can't back. Suggest: "Reduced median latency in our preview tests" and link to a published results page under embargo.

zara-partner: We can sign off on an embargoed results page. Spectra will provide a short login-protected artifact for reviewers.

sam: Owner notes: Diego = perf numbers & verified image, Toni = marketplace copy + assets, Meera = legal approvals, Zara = Spectra liaison + embargo artifact.

meera-legal: Also add SI kit checklist: terraform snippets, sample IAM roles, and a troubleshooting playbook. That simplifies partner enablement.

diego-eng: I'll add a tiny sample TF snippet to the repo. Example: 

```
provider "redwood" {
  region = "us-west-2"
}
module "spectra_preview" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/partner-tiles.git//spectra"
  instance_type = "rwd.gpu.large"
}
```

Will include expected perf ranges and verified driver versions.

toni-pp: For launch cadence: internal readout -> partner preview demo -> embargoed press -> marketplace tile -> public blog. Suggest we aim for 6 weeks end-to-end (EAP start -> public blog). Is that realistic?

zara-partner: Spectra's timeline aligns but they want the marketplace listing live sooner for SI training. Maybe we can do a "private marketplace" listing visible to partners only — is that supported?

diego-eng: We can create a private listing for partners. Ops will need the allowlist for partner accounts. Also we should include a lab image with preloaded KV snapshots for reproducible tests.

meera-legal: Make sure partner-only listings still honor the NDA terms. Any marketplace assets containing logs or traces need redaction.

sam: Action items and rough ETA: Diego: validated perf + image (10d), Toni: draft copy + assets (7d), Meera: legal signoff + embargo checklist (5d), Zara: partner artifact + SI training dates (7d).

deploy-bot: <ticket-RWI-888> created: SPECTRA-MKTPLACE-ONRAMP - private listing + SI kit (assignee: diego-eng).

toni-pp: Also want to capture success metrics for the preview: 1) partner SI completion (3 partners), 2) median latency within target range, 3) first 30-day customer onboardings via marketplace. We'll include these in the postmortem.

zara-partner: We'll coordinate SI invites once we have the private tile ready. Spectra can host two training sessions.

diego-eng: Quick tech ask: Spectra engineers asked if we can expose a sanitized perf trace format (JSONL) with keys: seq_len, tokens/s, median_latency_ms. Any objections?

meera-legal: Sanitize and aggregate only. No user-level data. Approve format if it excludes request text.

sam: OK. Final note: please keep this thread for updates only. I'll set a weekly 30-min sync until launch.

zara-partner: Thanks — will share Spectra's embargo calendar and initial assets by EOD tomorrow.

diego-eng: Working on the image build now, will push an initial AMI and a readme to the partner repo.

toni-pp: I'll post the first copy draft to the PR and ping this channel. :sparkles:
